decisionReason: Locked run 31305525552 produced evidence fnv1a64:747cdbc38b0e9258 and confirmed the predeclared source-4 signature. L19 transverse RMS residual fell from 129.1410163302373 to 13.133924786885553 and transverse max absolute residual fell from 216.14933188832492 to 29.972807796732013; all eight tracked transverse FY/FZ/MY/MZ end components improved and none worsened. Specifically FROM FY residual changed +156.317109 N to -14.444101 N and FROM MZ changed -216.149332 N.m to +7.974756 N.m. The diagnostic shear parameters were phiXY=phiXZ=0.06922470962067039 from the exact BM4 frame state with kappa=0.53. Axial FX residual remained exactly unchanged at about 0.008536 N, proving the improvement is transverse-stiffness specific and does not alter pressure axial mechanics. L20 transverse RMS similarly fell 999.4957054520269 to 49.8973960556368 while the previously isolated thermal axial residual remained exactly unchanged at 156561.00443630805 N. This strongly supports missing straight-pipe shear deformation as a real constitutive defect, but no system-level production change is accepted yet; the next gate must sweep the same authority across the wider population of plain FRAME sources to rule out a source-4 coincidence.
